title: Control Axis: Regularized 24-Layer HfO2/SiO2 Thickness Optimization
scientific_hypothesis: A 24-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack, with thicknesses optimized under inter-layer variance regularization, can simultaneously achieve high transmittance in 1530-1565 nm and high reflectance in 400-700 nm on fused silica.
design_principle: Recalled knowledge: Alternating high/low index layers create a photonic stopband centered at the quarter-wave wavelength. By centering the stopband in the visible (approx 550 nm), the IR band (1550 nm) falls in a transmission harmonic. Regularization prevents non-manufacturable thickness oscillations.
proposed_topology: 24 layers total. Sequence: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica Substrate.
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band
Maximize mean reflectance in 400-700 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: Adjacent layer thickness differences should be minimized via regularization
theory_basis: Recalled knowledge: Quarter-wave stacks reflect strongly at design wavelength lambda0 where optical thickness nd = lambda0/4
Recalled knowledge: Higher index contrast (HfO2/SiO2) yields wider stopbands than lower contrast pairs
Recalled knowledge: Regularization in optimization prevents non-manufacturable thickness oscillations between adjacent layers
expected_advantages: Improved robustness compared to unregularized optimization
Faster convergence by initializing near a known high-performing manifold
known_risks: Recalled HfO2 absorption in visible range may limit reflectance if extinction coefficient k > 0 (values read from registry)
Stress in 24-layer stack may cause delamination (not modeled in TMM)
Exact refractive index dispersion values are measured data from registry, not assumed constants
execution_request_english: Optimize a 24-layer stack on Fused Silica substrate with Air incident. Materials: hfo2, SiO2 (Lemarchand). Sequence: [hfo2, SiO2 (Lemarchand)] repeated 12 times. Initialize thicknesses using the following array (nm): [65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.4, 105.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 105.0, 66.2, 105.0, 105.0, 105.0, 65.0, 105.0, 105.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 65.0, 86.0] with Gaussian perturbation (std dev 10 nm). Bounds: center +/- 20 nm. Objective: Maximize mean T (1530-1565 nm) and mean R (400-700 nm). Apply inter-layer thickness variance regularization with coefficient increased by 15% relative to prior round. Normal incidence. Unpolarized.
revision_reason: Continuation of control axis with refined initialization and regularization based on prior round performance.
